lernapps.github.io.message:
fix(lernapps-frame): put the frame in outside the page's scripts

## Intent

A bundled app, such as the biz42 and pdt42 diff pages, carries "</head>" as text inside a script in its head. The frame put its head links in at the first "</head>", inside that script. Since the frame's head now holds the language script, its closing tag ended the bundle early, and the rest became markup with broken links.

## Key changes

- lernapps-frame looks up </head>, <body> and the last </body> outside script elements.

## Dependencies and side effects

- lernapps/docs 59b3913, lernapps/tooling 1dc81c3 and lernapps/apps e7246d5 pin this fix.
